filters.purpose: Import the original public AA6016 T4 LabDCT crop only, retaining millimeter geometry and source grain IDs. Convert PhaseId to Int32 and inverse-convention Rodrigues triples to NX unit-axis/magnitude form. Preserve source IPF001 float colors: built-in compatible-color conversion fails on this single-direction file (#1805). Omit the much larger AbsorptionCT volume because this task does not register scans or reproduce the paper strain analysis.
Retain supplied mask, positive phase and positive grain identity together. All 1,650,000 cells pass for this public crop; the mask is an admission contract, not an added completeness threshold.

Convert the reader-produced four-component Rodrigues representation to Bunge Euler radians. The reader already inverted the source convention; do not conjugate again or apply an EBSD acquisition-frame correction.
Recompute sample-Z IPF colors using the DREAM3D-NX cubic color key and compatible orientations. These are the colors to pair with the NX legend; stored vendor colors use their own convention.

Scale the original normalized vendor RGB components to UInt8 for display, retaining the original float array. This explicit single-array conversion avoids issue 1805 but does not change the vendor color legend.

Create the per-grain table using original GrainId values and summarize the supplied reconstruction completeness. Row 0 stays unused; all 1,666 positive IDs are occupied. Completeness is a reconstruction field, not a measured strain or a statistical probability.

Measure voxel counts, observed volume in cubic millimeters and equal-volume sphere diameter in millimeters. Preserve the source 0.004 mm spacing. A grain cut by the crop has only its observed fraction measured here; this is not its whole-grain size.
Flag grains touching any of the six faces of this released crop. Crop faces are not physical specimen free surfaces. Use the flag before interpreting observed volumes as complete grains.

Retain phase identity alongside the original grain IDs; all positive grains must stay phase 1, cubic-high aluminum. Investigate a mixed-phase warning rather than treating it as a new phase assignment.

Audit the paper/catalogue 27-voxel statement without deleting measured crop data. This download contains grain 1049 with 23 voxels at a crop face; preserve and flag it. Feature 0 is excluded explicitly.

Export all 1,666 occupied grain rows with their original Feature_ID, completeness, observed sizes, phase and crop/small-fragment flags. The feature writer omits reserved row 0; it does not renumber the grains.

Export all measured crop voxels in X-fastest order: three Euler degrees, one-based X/Y/Z indices, original GrainId and PhaseId. Feed original NX radians: the writer converts internally and rounds to three decimal places. Spacing, physical origin, material laws, loading and boundary conditions are not included; this is microstructure data, not a validated FFT simulation.

Export original grain IDs as one integer value per one-based site, preserving X-fastest ordering. The Values-only file requires an already defined compatible box, sites and neighbors; its header does not construct a lattice. It carries no orientations, phases or physical scale. Potts-state use is a separate modeling choice, not the paper CP-FE workflow; cropped faces are not proven periodic.

Save the unchanged reconstruction labels and scalar fields, explicit orientation/color conversions, source phase metadata and grain preparation table. No segmentation, small-grain removal, Neper meshing, DIC or CP-FE simulation is performed. Preserve the native arrays beside the two independent simulation-interchange text products.
